note: Pinned revisions for the three Linux modules the site documents, each verified against the GitHub API before being written here. Only Ada publishes tags; Ampere and Turing publish neither tags nor releases, so their pin is the branch head at the time of recording and `ref` says so. A drifted revision does not fail a build — upstream moves independently of this site — it fails `npm run check:upstream`, which reports the change so the card and benchmark data can be re-read against the new revision.
